sectors.trend: Iron ore sentiment softens with 'roaches seethe' commentary; however WA exploration pipeline (Dalaroo Cu-Ni-PGE, Critica rare earths, Augustus gold) provides offsetting upside. AUD weakness supports exporter revenue.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term iron ore headwinds but AUD depreciation cushions. Exploration names (CRL.AX, AUG.AX) offer speculative upside. Rare earths theme gaining policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Big four banks advance on easing bond yields and oil prices. RBA inflation warning and IMF fiscal caution signal potential further tightening, supporting NIMs but pressuring credit growth.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher-for-longer rates. State borrowing costs rising (headline 57) may pressure sovereign-linked credit. Housing affordability stress a medium-term credit risk.

sectors.trend: LNG export surge to Japan starves east-coast domestic supply; fuel distributor supply crunch triggers petrol price shock. Victoria retreats from renewable transmission; federal policy tilts toward coal.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX face domestic supply constraints but strong export pricing. Coal names (BRL.AX, WES.AX coal segment) gain policy support. Renewable developers (IGT.AX, LEM.AX) face headwind from Victoria's retreat.

sectors.trend: Coles exercises pricing power on milk despite removing farmer support; QantasLink and ground staff threaten strikes ahead of school holidays. Fashion brands Cue and Veronika Maine near collapse.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CSG.AX retain margin resilience but face reputational/ACCC risk. QAN.AX faces operational disruption risk from industrial action. Consumer discretionary under pressure from fuel costs.

sectors.trend: Anthropic's $31bn QLD datacentre deal signals major capex inflow. AI adoption narrative strong globally (Zuckerberg, Huang). ACCC targets real estate tech monopoly.
sectors.implications: Datacentre/infrastructure beneficiaries: WES.AX (power), A2M.AX, SGP.AX. ACCC action may disrupt REIT/property-tech valuations. AI capex supports long-term tech theme.

sectors.trend: Housing affordability at record lows; tenants see modest rent relief. ACCC moves against real estate monopoly. States face soaring interest costs pressuring public housing.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face mixed signals: tenant relief caps rental growth but ACCC intervention may boost competition. Residential property sector under structural affordability stress.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate gains from Wall Street's six-week high but RBA inflation warning and potential rate hike cap upside. Fuel supply crunch and Qantas strikes create sector-specific volatility. AUD weakness supports miners but pressures importers. Expect range-bound ^AXJO with financials and energy outperforming.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural themes favour critical minerals (WA pipeline), AI/datacentre capex, and energy transition (despite Victoria's retreat). Housing affordability and fiscal tightening (IMF) pose medium-term headwinds. RBA policy path and Middle East geopolitics are key swing factors. China repositioning as safe haven may alter global capital flows into Australia.
